claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Diphenyleneiodonium at 2.5 uM most plausibly kills cells through its well-known off-target activity as a potent inhibitor of mitochondrial complex I and other flavoprotein oxidoreductases, producing broad, non-selective bioenergetic collapse rather than NOS inhibition.
